blocks.text: Presynaptic neuron ke axon terminal mein kai synaptic knobs hain jin mein bohat si synaptic vesicles neurotransmitters naam ke kimiyai maddon se bhari hain. Action potential ki maloomat synapse ke paar pohanchana synaptic transmission hai.

items: Action potential synaptic knobs tak pohanchta aur presynaptic membrane ke calcium gates khulte hain.
Calcium ions cleft se tezi se presynaptic axon mein diffuse hote hain.
Calcium ki wajah se synaptic vesicles membrane se mil kar exocytosis ke zariye neurotransmitter chhorti hain.
Neurotransmitter cleft paar kar ke postsynaptic membrane ke receptor proteins se judta hai.
Yeh judna paigham ka kaam karta hai: postsynaptic membrane ke Na+ gates khulte aur wahan action potential banta hai.
Neurotransmitter cleft mein nahi rehta: kai synapses par presynaptic neuron use wapas jazb kar leta, kuch par enzymes use tor dete hain.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf presynaptic axon terminal jo neurotransmitter ki vesicles se bhara hai, beech mein tang cleft, aur daen taraf receptor proteins wala postsynaptic cell. Ca2+ terminal mein dakhil hota, neurotransmitter cleft mein chhoota, receptors se judta, aur Na+ postsynaptic cell mein ja kar naya impulse shuru karta hai. Neeche chhe number wale qadam likhe hain.
blocks.caption: Synapse ki banawat aur synaptic transmission ka tareeqa (Figure 15.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Jab action potential synaptic knobs tak pohanchta hai to calcium gates khulte aur Ca2+ cleft se andar diffuse hota hai. Is se synaptic vesicles membrane se mil kar exocytosis ke zariye neurotransmitter chhorti hain. Neurotransmitter cleft paar kar ke postsynaptic membrane ke receptor proteins se judta hai, jis ke Na+ gates khulte aur wahan action potential shuru hota hai. Baad mein transmitter presynaptic neuron wapas le leta ya enzymes use tor dete hain.

blocks.title: Zyada impulses, zyada transmitter
blocks.text: Presynaptic axon mein action potentials jitni zyada baar aayein, utna zyada neurotransmitter chhoota hai.

blocks.prompt: Impulse synapse ko sirf aik simt mein kyun paar karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Neurotransmitter ki vesicles sirf presynaptic knobs mein aur receptor proteins sirf postsynaptic membrane par hain. (Yeh dalil aam biology hai, kitab mein nahi likhi.)

items: Impulse pohanchta, Ca2+ andar, vesicles neurotransmitter chhorti, woh postsynaptic receptors se judta, Na+ gates khulte, transmitter wapas ya toot jata.
